_comment: Direction agreement per model, HUMAN-JUDGED. Transcribed by the reviewer from QUALITATIVE-REVIEW.md sections (d) — never recomputed by a script, because 'agree' / 'partial' are adjudications made while reading the artefacts and the images, not a string comparison. experiments/sime2026/fill-numbers.ts reads the top-level `models` map for the \AGR* macros and only reformats it as 'agree/of (agree+partial/of)'.
_status: FINAL-BUILD REVIEW. Re-scored 2026-09-09 against the complete re-run batch in experiments/sime2026/runs/ (62 runs, 61 exit 0). Supersedes the 2026-09-08 values, which were taken against a pre-final build and a partly failed run set and do not carry over.
caveat: Descriptive-direction agreement against NLP-mined ChestX-ray14 report labels (Wang et al., CVPR 2017, ~90% accurate) on 224x224 images, single frontal view, no clinical history. NOT accuracy, sensitivity or specificity. Read QUALITATIVE-REVIEW.md section 0 before quoting any of these.

directionKey.agree: the model's progression matches the net direction of the NIH label trajectory
directionKey.partial: endpoint-consistent but interval labels missed; or Stable against a fluctuating / non-monotonic trajectory; or the right direction reached via a finding outside the NIH label vocabulary
directionKey.noCall: Inconclusive; or a directional label emitted when fewer than half the sessions produced usable structured output

_cohortsComment: ADDITIVE, added 2026-09-09 for the 20-patient E4L cohort. fill-numbers.ts does not read this block today; the top-level `models` map above remains the E4 source of truth for \AGRGEM / \AGRGMA / \AGRQWN / \AGRCLD and is unchanged in shape. `agreePartial` is the count of agree + partial, matching formatAgreement()'s second figure.

crossCheck._comment: Mechanical first-vs-last label comparison in E5-label-agreement.json (directionRows / directionByModel / directionByModelStratum) versus this human adjudication. Differences are expected and are explained in QUALITATIVE-REVIEW.md section (h).
systematicDifferences: E5 discards evolution artefacts with validation.ok === false (6 runs scored '(no valid evolution artefact)'); this review adjudicates the recovered progression and the surviving combinedReport narrative.
E5 scores an expected 'Inconclusive' as a matchable value, so a model declining to answer can score agree (gemma, patient 00000008); this review scores that noCall.
E5 has no 'partial' category: an expected under-call at 224 px scores as a disagreement mechanically and as partial here.
E5 cannot see why a direction matched: 00000086/gemini agrees on direction for entirely fabricated reasons (failure case F1).
